name: Kàngzhàn Shènglì 70 Zhōunián Dà Yuèbīng Zhè Tiān Wǒ Lǎopó Tūrán Xiāoshī Le
summary: In this age of information overload, we have too much information to process, too much knowledge to learn, and too many things to keep busy with. How does one live cleverly in such an era?
